company.name: EarnIn
company.shortDescription: EarnIn is an earnings management company that provides access to earned wages and financial wellness tools.
company.description: EarnIn provides a mobile application offering earned wage access and financial wellness tools. It enables eligible users to transfer a portion of their earned income, typically up to $150 per day or $750 per pay period, into a linked bank account, without mandatory fees, credit checks, or interest; optional tips are accepted instead. The platform also includes features like real-time earnings access through Live Pay, direct-deposit accelerations up to two days early, Balance Shield for overdraft protection, credit score monitoring, and a savings tool called Tip Yourself. The application integrates directly with users’ bank accounts and employment verification, and operates independently of employer payroll systems by design.

aiResearchSummary.text: EarnIn is researching systems and methods for allowing employees to access and use money earned but not yet paid by their employer, as described in the title 'System and method for automatic routing of wages.' The abstract details enabling workers to utilize unpaid wages for paying bills, purchasing goods and services, and accessing their earnings before the traditional pay cycle ends. This area of research and development focuses on wage access and financial flexibility for employees.
